scope: Separately research the lighthouse on Minto Hill and its exact anchor. Do not place it at the island story reference point.

facts: Minto Hill is approximately30m above sea level.
The standing lighthouse is an18m circular masonry tower painted white, reached by75stairs.
sources.inspection: Museum-authored text read; accompanying unknown-creator photograph is not used.

sources.publisher: William Martinson, firsthand architectural site account, December2019
facts: Circular as-built plan differs from the unbuilt1859octagonal design.
Base circumference measured21.25m; chamfer links cylindrical base to tapered masonry shaft.
Recessed east entrance has paired panelled timber leaves and a granite threshold.
East shaft carries a black navigation stripe. Eight shaft sash openings lie on door and cross axes; a lower opening is opposite the door.
Main gallery has curved metal balusters; a higher narrow gallery provides lantern access.
Lantern has sixteen alternating tapered window frames with three vertical tiers of glass; the curved cap has twelve segments.
sources.inspection: Factual written site observations only. Page photograph and historical drawing are excluded from active imagery.

sources.publisher: Lighthouses South Africa, Robben Island fact file
facts: Round masonry tower,18m high, white with a black vertical eastern stripe and red lantern.
